aurora-x1-pro.title: Xingye AURORA X1 Pro 5G Smartphone
aurora-x1-pro.subtitle: 200MP imaging system, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, 5400mAh silicon-carbon battery
aurora-x1-pro.description: A 6.78-inch 2K LTPO eye-care display with 1-120Hz adaptive refresh. The 200MP main camera pairs with a periscope telephoto for 43% better low-light yield, while the 5400mAh silicon-carbon battery supports 120W wired and 50W wireless charging for 80% in 30 minutes.

aurora-tab-11.title: Xingye AURORA Pad 11 Tablet
aurora-tab-11.subtitle: 11-inch 144Hz display, magnetic keyboard and stylus support
aurora-tab-11.description: An 11-inch 2.8K 144Hz full-screen panel with TUV eye-care certification. The octa-core chip and 8GB base memory keep split-screen multitasking smooth, backed by an 8600mAh battery and quad speakers for both media and note-taking.

aurora-watch-s.title: Xingye AURORA Watch S Smartwatch
aurora-watch-s.subtitle: 14-day battery, dual-band GPS, 100+ sport modes
aurora-watch-s.description: A 1.43-inch always-on AMOLED display in a 32g titanium case. It offers dual-band five-constellation positioning, continuous blood-oxygen and heart-rate monitoring, and 5ATM water resistance with a typical 14-day battery life.

echo-buds-3.title: Xingye ECHO Buds 3 True Wireless ANC Earbuds
echo-buds-3.subtitle: 48dB hybrid ANC, spatial audio, 8-hour single-charge playback
echo-buds-3.description: A dual-feed noise-cancelling architecture reaches 48dB with a natural transparency mode. The 11mm driver supports LDAC high-resolution audio and spatial audio, with 32 hours total playback including the charging case and wireless charging support.

nucleus-book-14.title: Xingye NUCLEUS Book 14 Ultrabook
nucleus-book-14.subtitle: 2.8K 120Hz display, 1.29kg metal chassis, 75Wh battery
nucleus-book-14.description: A 14-inch 2.8K 120Hz low blue-light display covering 100% sRGB. The all-metal body weighs 1.29kg and opens to 180 degrees, while the 75Wh battery and 100W fast charging deliver up to 11 hours of office work.

nucleus-monitor-27.title: Xingye NUCLEUS 27-inch 4K Monitor
nucleus-monitor-27.subtitle: 4K IPS Black, 98% DCI-P3, 90W power delivery
nucleus-monitor-27.description: A 27-inch 4K IPS Black panel with 2000:1 contrast, factory-calibrated to Delta E below 2. It powers a laptop over a single 90W USB-C cable, includes a built-in KVM and dual 3W speakers, and mounts on a tool-free height-adjustable stand.

nucleus-keyboard-k8.title: Xingye NUCLEUS K8 Tri-mode Mechanical Keyboard
nucleus-keyboard-k8.subtitle: Gasket mount, hot-swappable, wired / Bluetooth / 2.4G
nucleus-keyboard-k8.description: A 75% layout that keeps the full function row, with a gasket mount and five-layer dampening for a soft typing feel. Every key is hot-swappable for three- and five-pin switches, and the 4000mAh battery lasts 200 hours with lighting off.

cloud-home-tv-65.title: Yunqi 65-inch Mini LED Smart TV
cloud-home-tv-65.subtitle: Thousand-zone backlight, 144Hz, Dolby Vision
cloud-home-tv-65.description: A 65-inch Mini LED panel with 1152 dimming zones and 1500nits peak brightness. 144Hz refresh with MEMC, Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos support, 4GB+64GB storage and no boot ads.

cloud-home-fridge-520.title: Yunqi 520L Cross-door Frost-free Refrigerator
cloud-home-fridge-520.subtitle: A-class efficiency, baby-food zone, full-cavity purification
cloud-home-fridge-520.description: A 520L cross-door layout with an independent baby-food zone adjustable from -20C to 5C. Dual-cycle frost-free cooling keeps produce crisp for 7 days, and A-class efficiency uses about 0.85 kWh per day.

cloud-home-washer-10.title: Yunqi 10kg Front-load Washer-Dryer
cloud-home-washer-10.subtitle: Direct-drive inverter, air wash, high-temperature tub clean
cloud-home-washer-10.description: A 10kg washer with 7kg drying capacity driven by a quiet, durable BLDC direct-drive motor. Air wash removes cooking and smoke odours, and 95C tub cleaning with dual spray reduces detergent residue.

cloud-home-oven-32.title: Yunqi 32L Built-in Steam Oven
cloud-home-oven-32.subtitle: Steam, bake, air-fry and sous-vide in one, 1C precision
cloud-home-oven-32.description: A 32L built-in cavity sized for standard cabinets that steams, bakes, air-fries and slow-cooks. Independent top and bottom control holds 1C precision, with 40 automatic menus and high-temperature steam self-cleaning.

shiguang-merino-coat.title: Shiguang Men's Merino Wool Coat
shiguang-merino-coat.subtitle: 90% Australian merino, double-faced wool, relaxed straight cut
shiguang-merino-coat.description: A double-faced cloth in 90% Australian merino wool, hand-finished without lining so it stays crisp yet light. The relaxed straight shoulder line suits both commuting and business, in navy and charcoal.

shiguang-cashmere-sweater.title: Shiguang Women's Cashmere Crewneck Sweater
shiguang-cashmere-sweater.subtitle: 100% cashmere, 12-gauge fine knit, soft against skin
shiguang-cashmere-sweater.description: Inner Mongolian 100% cashmere in a 12-gauge fine knit that feels light and smooth. The crewneck drop-shoulder cut flatters the shoulder line and layers easily, with a matching cashmere care comb included.

shiguang-runner-shoes.title: Shiguang LIGHT Runner Cushioned Running Shoes
shiguang-runner-shoes.subtitle: Supercritical foam midsole, 218g per shoe, commute and jog
shiguang-runner-shoes.description: A supercritical foam midsole returns 68% of energy at just 218g per shoe. The one-piece knit upper breathes and hugs the foot, and the abrasion-resistant rubber outsole handles asphalt and treadmill alike.

shiguang-canvas-tote.title: Shiguang Canvas Commuter Tote
shiguang-canvas-tote.subtitle: 16oz heavy canvas, fits a 16-inch laptop, three inner pockets
shiguang-canvas-tote.description: A 16oz heavy canvas tote with vegetable-tanned leather handles rated to 12kg. The main compartment holds a 16-inch laptop flat, with three inner pockets and a key clip, and the strap length adjusts for commuting or short trips.

mubai-hydra-serum.title: Mubai HYDRA Hyaluronic Hydrating Serum 30ml
mubai-hydra-serum.subtitle: Five-weight hyaluronic acid, alcohol-free, fragrance-free
mubai-hydra-serum.description: Five hyaluronic acid weights build a layered hydration network while ectoine soothes and repairs. Free of alcohol, fragrance and colourants, it suits sensitive skin, absorbs quickly and layers under moisturiser.

mubai-velvet-lipstick.title: Mubai VELVET Matte Lipstick
mubai-velvet-lipstick.subtitle: Velvet matte finish, 8-hour wear, squalane enriched
mubai-velvet-lipstick.description: A velvet matte texture that colours in one pass and lasts eight hours without transferring. Squalane and vitamin E keep the matte finish comfortable, and the magnetic metal case ships with a matching lip liner.

mubai-repair-shampoo.title: Mubai Repair Amino Shampoo 500ml
mubai-repair-shampoo.subtitle: Amino-acid surfactants, silicone-free, colour-treated repair
mubai-repair-shampoo.description: Amino-acid surfactants cleanse gently without the silicone slip. Hydrolysed keratin and panthenol improve dryness and split ends after colouring or perming, in a 500ml pump bottle for the whole family.

shanhai-rice-5kg.title: Shanhai Wuchang Daohuaxiang Rice 5kg
shanhai-rice-5kg.subtitle: New-season harvest, core growing region, vacuum sealed
shanhai-rice-5kg.description: New-season Daohuaxiang No.2 from the Wuchang core region of Heilongjiang, harvested once a year with plump glossy grains. Vacuum sealing preserves the aroma, and the cooked rice is soft, sweet and ideal as a daily staple.

shanhai-nuts-gift.title: Shanhai Daily Nut Gift Box, 30 Packs
shanhai-nuts-gift.subtitle: Six nuts and dried fruit, individually packed, no added sugar
shanhai-nuts-gift.description: Thirty individually packed servings with six nuts and dried fruits including almonds, cashews, walnut kernels and cranberries. Low-temperature roasting keeps the aroma without added sugar or preservatives, perfect for the office or travel.

shanhai-orange-5kg.title: Shanhai Gannan Navel Oranges 5kg
shanhai-orange-5kg.subtitle: Shipped from origin, 18:1 sweet-sour ratio, spoiled-fruit refund
shanhai-orange-5kg.description: Shipped directly from Gannan, Jiangxi, with 70-80mm fruit and a sweet-sour ratio around 18:1. Orders leave within 24 hours of picking on a cold chain, and any spoiled fruit is refunded on photo evidence.

senyu-treadmill.title: Senyu Quiet Folding Home Treadmill
senyu-treadmill.subtitle: 2.5HP quiet motor, folds flat, cushioned deck
senyu-treadmill.description: A 2.5HP brushless motor runs as quietly as 55dB, and the six-point cushioned deck reduces impact on knees and ankles. The tool-free folding design stores at 19cm thick for compact homes.

senyu-tent-3.title: Senyu 3-Person Pop-up Tent
senyu-tent-3.subtitle: Three-second setup, double-layer rainproof, silver-coated UV shield
senyu-tent-3.description: A hydraulic frame pitches in three seconds beneath a double-layer shell rated PU3000mm. The silver-coated fly reflects UV, a skylight and two doors create cross-ventilation, and the packed weight is only 3.2kg for parks and light camping.

senyu-dumbbell-set.title: Senyu Adjustable Dumbbell Set 20kg
senyu-dumbbell-set.subtitle: Fast weight change, rubber-coated grip, pair set
senyu-dumbbell-set.description: A dial adjusts each dumbbell from 2.5kg to 10kg in one turn. Rubber-coated plates are quiet and floor-friendly, and the pair ships with storage bases for space-saving strength training at home.

qimu-formula-800.title: Qimu Organic Infant Formula 800g
qimu-formula-800.subtitle: Organic milk source, OPO structured fat, traceable batch
qimu-formula-800.description: Made from organic pasture milk with OPO structured fat and prebiotic blends that mirror breast-milk fat structure. Each tin carries a unique traceability code covering farm, production and inspection records.

qimu-blocks-200.title: Qimu Large Building Blocks, 200 Pieces
qimu-blocks-200.subtitle: Food-grade ABS, rounded edges, build guide included
qimu-blocks-200.description: Two hundred large blocks in food-grade ABS with polished rounded edges for children aged three and up. A 24-page build guide and storage tub support spatial thinking and hand-eye coordination.
